The '''Ironfleck Marauders''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that were based on the [[Adamant Mass]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|116|Ironfleck Marauders}}</ref>

In space battles, the Ironfleck Marauders flew [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]] and [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>
